author: TEDx Talks
description:
Have you ever felt misunderstood, knowing that your inner capabilities aren't translating to the outside world? With 25 years of experience studying nonverbal communication, expert and former Stanford instructor Cara Hale Alter breaks down the metrics behind "Visible Credibility." In this practical and engaging talk, she reveals how intentional adjustments to your posture and voice can help you uncover your blind spots and align your outward presence with your true self. Discover how to master these foundational skills so that your confidence, leadership, and competence are always immediately recognized by others. Having lectured at Harvard, Stanford, UCLA, and UC Berkeley, Cara Hale Alter's focus has always been the same: helping talented people make their credibility visible. After more than 25 years of research into how nonverbal communication shapes leadership presence, she has seen one truth repeat itself—ability alone isn’t enough if no one recognizes it.

As the founder of Spee
title: Your nonverbal cues shape your credibility—here’s how | Cara Hale Alter | TEDxUofW

author: TEDx Talks
description: Robots can't act until someone writes down what they should optimize for, something humans have never managed to do for happiness. Drawing on work hunting for Planet Nine, launching rockets, building off-road robots with DARPA, and studying astronaut cognition with NASA, Lakshay Sharma explores what building intelligent systems teaches us about our own decisions. He argues that robotics works as a mirror for how we live: our surroundings are our training data, and we have to choose deliberately when to stick with what we know and when to explore. Lakshay Sharma is a robotics engineer who founded and serves as the CEO of Cerulion, a robotics middleware service that provides efficient, excellent ways to build, test, and deploy robots. A Penn and MIT alum, his academic and professional experiences point to the argument that the way in which robots are designed reveals the assumptions held by their designers more than the limitations of the technology itself. This talk was given at a TEDx
title: Can robots teach you how to live? | Lakshay Sharma | TEDxPenn

author: TEDx Talks
description: If you could automate everything in your life, where would you stop? AI strategist and former GTM of OpenAI, Zack Kass introduces the "Automation Boundary," the shifting line between what we hand off to machines and what we keep for ourselves. He argues that while technology should erase the "vicious friction" that causes suffering, our future depends on protecting the "virtuous friction" (struggle, discipline, conflict, and failure) that builds character, capability, and community. Zack Kass is a global AI advisor and the former Head of GTM for OpenAI. Following his experience publicly launching ChatGPT, he now advises Fortune 1000 companies on AI strategy. In addition to his professional roles, he is an Executive-in-Residence at the University of Virginia. Kass recently authored a book The Next RenAIssance detailing the implications of AI on society at-large. As an avid techno-optimist, Kass specializes in rewriting the prevalent dystopian narrative on technology in the media. This
title: When do we stop automating? | Zack Kass | TEDxPenn

author: TEDx Talks
description:
What does a bone marrow transplant teach us about hope, resilience and being human?

In this deeply moving talk, Dr Nidhi Jain shares what decades of caring for patients have taught her about life beyond medicine.

Through the story of a young patient whose biggest concern during a difficult transplant journey was whether he would one day be able to eat pani puri again, Dr Nidhi reminds us that patients don't simply want to survive, they want to live.

She reflects on the extraordinary resilience she witnesses every day, the role of human connection alongside medical technology, and the power of choosing hope even in the middle of uncertainty.

Because science can rebuild the blood.
But hope rebuilds people. Dr. Nidhi Jain is a Clinical Hematologist, Hemato-Oncologist, and Bone Marrow Transplant Specialist at Zydus Hospitals, Ahmedabad. With advanced training from premier institutions in India and Australia, including PGIMER Chandigarh, KEM Hospital Mumbai, and the Royal Melbourne Hos
title: What a bone marrow transplant taught me about being human | Dr Nidhi Jain | TEDxSukhna Lake

description: Karina Rosas, especialista en marketing digital y CEO con un equipo de 50 colaboradores, desmitifica los estigmas hacia la generación Z y comparte una guía práctica para sobresalir en el ámbito laboral durante tus 20s. A través de su experiencia liderando proyectos con marcas globales y festivales, Karina aborda por qué la paz no debe confundirse con la falta de esfuerzo, la importancia de ver tu tiempo y energía como tu divisa más valiosa, y por qué el enfoque y la obsesión siempre terminan superando al talento bruto. Karina Rosas es CEO y fundadora de Kool Studio, egresada de Mercadotecnia en el Tec de Monterrey, pionera en México con la primera agencia especializada en contenido y estrategias para TikTok, trabajando con marcas globales como Starbucks, Rappi, New Balance, Shein y Sigma Alimentos, ganadora de un TikTok Award y ponente en Advertising Week Latam. title: La guía oficial para triunfar en tu trabajo en tus 20s | Karina Rosas | TEDxTecDeMty

description: Patricia Armendáriz, economista, empresaria y referente del emprendimiento en México, nos invita a reflexionar sobre la estructura de nuestras vidas: ¿está compuesta por hilos sueltos y casualidades, o por un tapete finamente tejido con un propósito único? A través de sus aprendizajes en la economía, el sector bancario y su paso por Shark Tank, Patricia revela cómo descubrir tu "hilo conductor" permite superar techos de cristal, construir resiliencia y transformar cualquier proyecto en una misión de impacto imparable. Es una destacada economista, actuaria y política mexicana. Doctora por la Universidad de Columbia, fue vicepresidenta de la CNBV durante la crisis de 1994, directora en el BIS (Basilea) y fundadora de Financiera Sustentable. Actualmente es ex-participante de Shark Tank México, con experiencia en regulación financiera y emprendimiento social. author: TEDx Talks
description: ¿Cuántas grandes ideas o sueños has dejado pausados por miedo a no hacerlo perfecto desde el primer día? Gael Priego, documentador de experiencias y creador del proyecto Ideas de Altura, nos comparte cómo pasó dos años paralizado por el perfeccionismo hasta que entendió que cada intento es un boleto de lotería que te acerca a tus metas. Descubre por qué no necesitas ser un experto para comenzar, pero sí necesitas comenzar si quieres llegar a ser bueno. Es un creador de contenido de Monterrey, Nuevo León, es reconocido por videos virales en TikTok (más de 200,000 seguidores) e Instagram (+100,000), enfocados en humor, deporte, lifestyle, hikes y viajes; ademas de ser host del podcast Ideas con Altura. Su conexion con la generacion Z al viralizar experiencias cotidianas y fomentar conversaciones profundas desde su vivencia y aventura personal, lo hace ideal para TEDx por su autenticidad relatable y capacidad para inspirar a jóvenes a valorar el presente y construir comunidades digitales

description: Arquitecta, empresaria y fundadora de Líderes para la Arquitectura, la consultora profesional de referencia en habla hispana especializada en ayudar a arquitectos y profesionales del sector a construir estudios más rentables, sostenibles y preparados para los desafíos del futuro. Durante la última década ha acompañado a miles de estudios de arquitectura, diseño y construcción en Europa y Latinoamérica en procesos de transformación relacionados con estrategia de negocio, liderazgo, innovación y adaptación a un mercado cada vez más cambiante. Su trabajo parte de una convicción: las profesiones tradicionales no están condenadas a desaparecer, pero sí necesitan cuestionar sus modelos, actualizar sus competencias y redefinir el valor que aportan a la sociedad. Hoy combina su experiencia como arquitecta con la investigación sobre el impacto de la inteligencia artificial y los nuevos modelos de trabajo en el futuro de las profesiones. title: “El futuro de las profesiones esenciales” | Caterna De La Portilla | TEDxBarrioSanNicolasSalon

author: TEDx Talks
description: La arquitecta Claudia Faena fundó Claudia Faena Estudio hace más de veinte años. Desarrolló su carrera entre Buenos Aires y el exterior, participando en proyectos junto a estudios de renombre como Philippe Starck, Norman Foster y Zaha Hadid. Como Directora Creativa diseñó la identidad de marcas internacionales y desarrolló edificios, hoteles, oficinas, viviendas e interiores. También creó líneas de mobiliario diseñadas y personalizadas para cada proyecto. Su trabajo fue reconocido con diversos premios y difundido en publicaciones nacionales e internacionales. Desarrolló el concepto de Senseful Design, una metodología que incluye la neuroarquitectura y que integra diseño, percepción, luz, materiales y bienestar para crear espacios que generan experiencias sensoriales positivas. Su investigación sobre la energía y las frecuencias aplicadas al espacio busca mejorar la calidad de vida de las personas a través de la arquitectura. La arquitecta Claudia Faena fundó Claudia Faena Estudio hace
title: “Neuroarquitectura y Senseful Design” | Claudia Faena | TEDxBarrioSanNicolasSalon

author: TEDx Talks
description: When a young person commits a serious crime, our first instinct is often to ask, “What’s wrong with that child?” Preston Simpson challenges us to ask a different question: “What’s happening around that child?” Examining the complex causes of repeat youth offending, he argues that prevention, support, and rehabilitation offer a more effective path to safer communities than punishment alone. Preston enjoys basketball, gaming, and spending time at the gym. He competes in both under-18 and men's basketball competitions and values the discipline, teamwork, and commitment that sport teaches. Curious about the world around him and motivated by a desire to make a positive difference, Preston enjoys exploring big ideas and understanding the challenges facing his community. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx
title: The Cycle We Keep Missing | Preston Simpson | TEDxSt Marys College Youth

author: TEDx Talks
description: Nestor Alexander Haddaway opens with a joke before getting real — then tells the actual story behind his 1993 hit: dumped by his girlfriend, laughed at by his bandmates, rejected by every label in Germany, until a radio jingle turned it into a #9 chart hit within weeks. From there he moves into 30 years of hard-won relationship wisdom: respect before communication, and why the couples who make it aren't the ones who never fight. Stick around for the story of freezing in Clive Davis's office and how "What Is Love" ended up on SNL — and the line he closes on, about the one thing more powerful than any war. Nestor Alexander Haddaway is a German-Trinidadian singer whose 1993 anthem "What Is Love" became a global phenomenon, later immortalized by Saturday Night Live's cowbell sketch and still beloved by new generations today. He followed it with his debut album that same year and "The Drive" in 1995 (featuring "Catch a Fire" and "Fly Away"), then returned to his dance roots with "I Wanna B
title: How to Make a Hit Song | Nestor Alexander Haddaway | TEDxMarvila

author: TEDx Talks
description:
What if disagreement became a place to learn rather than a battle to win? Drawing on encounters in kitchens and communities around the world, Tareq Taylor explores how asking ‘What do you know that I don’t?’ can replace certainty with curiosity. His invitation is simple: meet difference by arriving as a student. Tareq Taylor is a Swedish chef, restaurateur and author whose work has long explored the relationship between food, culture and human connection. Through restaurants, television, books and entrepreneurship, he has spent decades meeting people across cultures and learning through the stories, traditions and knowledge carried through food.

Drawing on these encounters — as well as his own family history and experiences of migration and belonging — Tareq explores what can happen when we approach other people with curiosity rather than certainty. His work is grounded in a simple idea: we understand more when we arrive ready to learn. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the T
title: What do you know? Arrive as a student. | Tareq Taylor | TEDxMalmö

description: Siamo molto più bravi a difendere le nostre idee che a metterle alla prova. Il dubbio ci sembra una debolezza, eppure è l'unico strumento che abbiamo per correggere un errore prima che diventi una convinzione. Eugenio Radin spiega perché ammettere di non sapere è il punto di partenza del pensiero critico, non il suo fallimento. 𝗘𝗨𝗚𝗘𝗡𝗜𝗢 𝗥𝗔𝗗𝗜𝗡 - Divulgatore culturale, esperto di comunicazione, autore e filosofo. author: TEDx Talks
description: Della morte non si parla, nemmeno quando entra in casa nostra. La rimuoviamo per proteggerci, e così finiamo per vivere come se il tempo non finisse mai. Ines Testoni, che studia il rapporto tra cultura e fine vita, mostra come guardare il limite in faccia cambi il modo in cui usiamo i giorni che abbiamo. 𝗜𝗡𝗘𝗦 𝗧𝗘𝗦𝗧𝗢𝗡𝗜 - Docente universitaria, psicoterapeuta, filosofa, saggista e tra le 100 scienziate più influenti d’Italia. Ines dedica la sua vita e la sua attività di ricerca a un tema che la nostra cultura tende ad allontanare: la Death Education e l'elaborazione del lutto. Tra le massime autorità internazionali in campo tanatologico e allieva del filosofo Emanuele Severino, dirige programmi accademici su fine vita e arti terapie, vanta oltre 250 pubblicazioni scientifiche e si occupa da anni di prevenzione del suicidio, gestione dei traumi e violenza di genere. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn
title: Il segreto che tutti nascondiamo per paura di vivere | Ines Testoni | TEDxJesolo

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Quanto possiamo spingerci in profondità prima di incontrare il nostro limite?
Gianluca Genoni conosce questa domanda anche nel senso più letterale.
Apneista e conduttore televisivo, Genoni ha conquistato 18 record del mondo nelle diverse specialità dell’apnea, arrivando a raggiungere i 160 metri di profondità. Nel corso della sua carriera ha inoltre partecipato a importanti esperienze nell’ambito della ricerca medico-scientifica, tra cui 18 minuti e 3 secondi di apnea statica e la prima immersione in apnea in un lago a 5.100 metri di quota, ai piedi dell’Everest.
Ma Emozioni profonde non è soltanto una storia di record.
È un viaggio nel rapporto tra corpo, mente, paura, concentrazione e limite. È la storia di ciò che accade quando ci troviamo in un ambiente nel quale ogni respiro diventa una scelta e ogni metro verso il basso ci porta più lontano da ciò che conosciamo.
In ABISSI, Genoni ci mostra che la profondità non si misura soltanto con un numero.
A volte il vero abisso è quello c
title: Emozioni profonde | Gianluca Genoni | TEDxBellano

description:
In Italia si parla più volentieri di malattie che di stipendi. Il risultato è che arriviamo alle decisioni economiche più importanti della nostra vita senza averne mai discusso con nessuno. Matteo Spreafico racconta da dove nasce questo imbarazzo e perché costa caro, soprattutto a chi ha meno. 𝗠𝗔𝗧𝗧𝗘𝗢 𝗦𝗣𝗥𝗘𝗔𝗙𝗜𝗖𝗢 - Founder di @finanz_app , imprenditore ed esperto di educazione finanziaria.
Ideatore di Finanz — l’app che educa al mondo dei soldi e dell'economia e che conta oggi oltre 200.000 utenti in Italia ed è attiva in più di 12 Paesi —, ha trasformato la complessità del settore economico in un percorso di apprendimento accessibile a chiunque. description: Human beings are not defined by being purely good, but by their ability to recognize the potential for evil within themselves and still choose kindness. Evil and kindness are not simply opposites; the existence of selfishness, desire, and harmful impulses is what gives moral choice its meaning. By confronting rather than ignoring the darker aspects of human nature, we can better understand ourselves, resist harmful impulses, and consciously choose kindness. Rachel Han is a 16-year-old tenth-grade student who has a strong passion for Chinese history, culture, and archaeology. She has experience in artifact restoration and has traveled to over 64 ancient sites and tombs across China. Her interest extends beyond textbooks, carrying her passion for history and letting it guide her in her everyday life. title: The unspoken lesson | Rachel Han | TEDxBIBA Youth

description: A ogni gara porta con sé una malattia genetica che le riduce la capacità respiratoria. Non è la parte più interessante della storia, ed è esattamente questo il punto. Rachele Somaschini, pilota di rally, racconta cosa succede quando smetti di lasciare che una diagnosi decida chi sei. 𝗥𝗔𝗖𝗛𝗘𝗟𝗘 𝗦𝗢𝗠𝗔𝗦𝗖𝗛𝗜𝗡𝗜 - Pilota di rally professionista, istruttrice di guida, imprenditrice. Cresciuta tra i motori grazie alla passione del padre, ha trasformato i primi giri in pista in una carriera costellata di successi: quattro volte campionessa italiana rally, protagonista del Mondiale WRC2 e storica piloti della Dakar Classic, convive fin dalla nascita con la fibrosi cistica ed è ideatrice dell'iniziativa solidale "#CorrerePerUnRespiro", con cui raccoglie fondi per la ricerca scientifica. author: TEDx Talks
description: In this talk, Dr. Amett Kumar explores the core idea that the future is not created in a single moment it is built through daily, deliberate practice. He explains how we can plan our lives with a clear strategy, and how improvising and enhancing our daily habits can align them with our larger goals. The session focuses on moving away from vague, generic goals and instead defining accurate, specific goals backed by a solid strategy. Dr. Amit Kumar teaches the audience that consistent practice is the bridge connecting today's actions to tomorrow's desired future and it is through this practice that we can genuinely ‘create’ our future. Dr. Amiett Kumar is a best-selling author and the founder of Readers Books Club and Manifest Anything. With a community of over 6 million followers, his work focuses on helping people translate their aspirations into meaningful achievements through practical strategies, consistent habits and purposeful action. description:
Every person has an Everest—the challenge that demands courage, persistence, and belief.
This inspiring talk transforms the idea of climbing a mountain into a metaphor for overcoming life’s toughest obstacles.
Your Everest may be different from others, but the climb is uniquely yours. K. Siva Kumar was born and brought up in Ooty, Tamil Nadu, and joined the Indian Army in 2001 at the Madras Regimental Centre, Wellington. Because life isn’t just about reaching the next milestone—it’s about learning to live between them.

With humour and honesty, this talk explores overthinking, imagined scenarios, and the silent conversations that can hold us back from simply speaking.
Because sometimes, the conversation we fear most is the one we never give reality a chance to begin.

description:
What if the plans that break are not failures, but foundations for something greater?
A thought-provoking journey through nature, evolution, failure and unexpected possibilities that challenges our obsession with perfect plans.
Because sometimes, the most extraordinary life is built from the pieces of a plan that didn’t go as planned.
 Uttra U Mehran is a Grade 9 student with a strong passion for mathematics and academic excellence. Beyond the mountains and forests of the Nilgiris lies a story written not only in ancient remains, but in generations of tribal knowledge.
This fascinating journey explores archaeology, indigenous wisdom, and the challenges of uncovering history in the heart of the forest.
When the past meets the people who have lived alongside it, history comes alive in unexpected ways.
 Sudhakar Nalliyappan is a heritage researcher and Founding President of Yaakkai Heritage Trust, Coimbatore. He holds Master’s degrees in Tamil and Business Administration and is trained in archaeology and conservation techniques. His work combines field documentation, heritage management and community-oriented research. He served as Photo Documenter (3D Scanning) for the Loose Sculpture Project of the Tamil Nadu State Department of Archaeology (Coimbatore Region, 2024–2025) and is Principal Investigator of Pilot Project EAP1685, Dharmapuri. What if distraction isn’t always the enemy of focus?
With humour, experiments, magic, and real-life experiences, this talk explores why our minds wander—and how distraction can sometimes spark curiosity and discovery.
Because getting distracted may not mean losing focus; sometimes, it means finding a new idea.

description:
As AI gets better at answering questions, writing, and generating ideas, this talk asks a bigger question: What makes human thinking valuable?
With humour and relatable student experiences, it explores curiosity, judgement, creativity and the courage to question instead of simply accepting AI’s answers.
Because the future may not be humans versus AI, but humans using AI without forgetting how to think.

Why does a five-minute video feel irresistible while a five-minute study session feels impossible? This hilarious, relatable talk uncovers the psychology behind procrastination and why our brains keep choosing “later.”
From temporal discounting to the five stages of procrastination, it turns a familiar struggle into an entertaining lesson about how to finally get started.
Because you don’t need more motivation—you just need to start small, start now.
